cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Comfort Everyone Else
cards.instruction: Meet every painful moment by comforting someone else more intensely while your own distress becomes harder to hide.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I've made you soup. The choir rejecting us doesn't mean you should miss dinner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've set a bowl for yourself too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. So you won't have to eat alone. I'll butter your bread.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sit with me. I don't want you crying in the kitchen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All right. But take my bread too. I can't swallow yet, and you shouldn't have to ask twice.

mechanism: A grants permission for receiving care only by continuing to direct B's comfort as A's own distress leaks out.
confusable: Unlike ordinary hospitality, A denies personal need and turns B's concern into authorized extra care for B.
comparison: Shared rejection becomes a meal with an invitation to sit, distinct from the layoff tissue exchange.
seedUse: Use soup, own bowl and bread from D117; make S01 permissions govern the offered reciprocity.
